title: Bone Grafting for Dental Implants: Complete Guide 2026
seoTitle: Bone Grafting for Dental Implants: Types and Timeline
seoDescription: Learn when a bone graft is needed before implants, the graft types, healing times and costs. Plan your implant path with our Valencia team.
excerpt: Why thin jawbone can delay an implant, how autografts, allografts, xenografts and synthetics compare, and what grafting does to your timeline and budget.
keyTakeaways: A graft rebuilds lost jawbone so an implant has enough volume to integrate and support a crown or bridge.
Graft material can come from your own bone, a human donor, an animal source or a synthetic product.
Socket grafts often allow implants in three to four months; ridge augmentations and sinus lifts take four to nine.
Increasing pain after 72 hours, fever, drainage or visible graft material should be checked promptly.
A CBCT scan is used to measure bone and decide between staged and same-day implant placement.
